title: Little Stories in Pictures
text:
Many people enjoy comic strips. A comic strip is a short story told in pictures and words. Each strip has a few boxes, called panels. Characters talk in bubbles, and the story is easy to follow.

Garfield is a famous comic strip. It is about a funny orange cat who is lazy and loves to sleep. Many newspapers print comic strips every day.

options: A short story told in pictures and words
A long book with no pictures

questions.text: What can we infer about why comic strips are popular?
options: They are short and mix pictures with words
They are long and have no pictures
They are written in a different language

questions.text: What can we infer about Garfield's personality?
options: He is lazy and likes to rest

vocabulary.definition: the boxes that separate the pictures in a comic strip
shapes that contain the words the characters say
not wanting to work or be active
printed publications with news and articles, usually sold every day

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas gostam de tirinhas. Uma tirinha é uma história curta contada com desenhos e palavras. Cada tirinha tem algumas caixas, chamadas painéis. Os personagens falam em balões, e a história é fácil de acompanhar.
Garfield é uma tirinha famosa. Trata-se de um gato laranja engraçado que é preguiçoso e adora dormir. Muitos jornais publicam tirinhas todos os dias.
